title: 點餐
description: 點餐時常用的表達方式

sentences.en: I'd like to start with the mushroom soup as an appetizer, followed by the grilled chicken breast with mashed potatoes.
sentences.zh: 我想先來一份蘑菇湯作為開胃菜，然後是烤雞胸肉配馬鈴薯泥。

sentences.en: Could I get the burger without onions and with extra cheese on the side, since I'm a bit picky about toppings?
sentences.zh: 我可以要一個不加洋蔥、起司另外放的漢堡嗎？因為我對配料有點挑剔。

sentences.en: We haven't decided yet, so could you give us a few more minutes to look through the menu carefully?
sentences.zh: 我們還沒決定好，所以能再給我們幾分鐘仔細看看菜單嗎？

sentences.en: I'll have whatever the person at the next table is having, because it looks absolutely incredible from here.
sentences.zh: 我要跟隔壁桌那個人一樣的，因為從這裡看起來真的非常棒。

sentences.en: Is it possible to substitute the fries for a side salad, as I'm trying to watch my carbohydrate intake lately?
sentences.zh: 可以把薯條換成配菜沙拉嗎？因為我最近在控制碳水化合物的攝取。

sentences.en: For my main course, I'd like the pan-seared salmon with asparagus, cooked medium if that's an option.
sentences.zh: 主菜我想要香煎鮭魚配蘆筍，如果可以的話煎到五分熟。

sentences.en: Could you make the curry less spicy than usual, because my stomach has been a bit sensitive this week?
sentences.zh: 咖哩可以做得比平常不那麼辣嗎？因為我這週胃有點敏感。

sentences.en: I'm not sure what to order, so could you tell me which dishes are the most popular among customers who come here often?
sentences.zh: 我不確定要點什麼，你能告訴我哪些菜是常來的客人之中最受歡迎的嗎？

sentences.en: We'd like to order two large pizzas to share among the group, one with pepperoni and one that's vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 我們想點兩個大披薩大家一起分享，一個辣味香腸的，一個素食的。

sentences.en: I noticed on the menu that there's a lunch special, which includes a drink and dessert — I'll go with that.
sentences.zh: 我注意到菜單上有午餐特餐，包含飲料和甜點——我就選那個。

sentences.en: My daughter, who is a vegetarian, would like to know if the spring rolls contain any meat or animal-based broth.
sentences.zh: 我女兒是素食者，她想知道春捲裡面是否有肉或動物性高湯。

sentences.en: Instead of the regular bread basket, could we get the garlic bread that I saw listed under the appetizer section?
sentences.zh: 我們可以不要一般的麵包籃，改成我在開胃菜區看到的大蒜麵包嗎？

sentences.en: I'll take the chef's special for today, along with a glass of whatever white wine you think pairs best with it.
sentences.zh: 我要今天的主廚特餐，再配一杯你覺得最搭的白酒。

sentences.en: Since we're in a bit of a hurry, could you let us know which items on the menu can be prepared the quickest?
sentences.zh: 因為我們有點趕時間，你能告訴我們菜單上哪些可以最快準備好嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like my coffee served after the meal rather than with it, and could you make it a double espresso instead?
sentences.zh: 我想要咖啡在餐後再上而不是一起，而且可以改成雙份濃縮咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: Could we get one order of nachos to share as a starter while we take our time deciding on the main courses?
sentences.zh: 我們可以先點一份墨西哥玉米片分著吃，同時慢慢決定主菜嗎？

sentences.en: The set menu, which comes with soup, a main dish, and dessert, seems like a much better deal than ordering separately.
sentences.zh: 套餐包含湯、主菜和甜點，看起來比單點划算得多。

sentences.en: I'm allergic to peanuts and tree nuts, so could you please double-check with the kitchen before preparing my order?
sentences.zh: 我對花生和堅果過敏，所以能請你在準備我的餐點前跟廚房再確認一下嗎？

sentences.en: We'll have the family platter, which should be enough for five people according to what it says on the menu.
sentences.zh: 我們要家庭拼盤，根據菜單上寫的應該夠五個人吃。

sentences.en: I've been craving seafood all week, so I'll go with the mixed seafood platter that comes with garlic butter sauce.
sentences.zh: 我整個禮拜都想吃海鮮，所以我要那個附蒜味奶油醬的綜合海鮮拼盤。

sentences.en: Could I add an extra side of coleslaw to my order, and also a bowl of the tomato soup that's on the daily specials?
sentences.zh: 我可以加點一份涼拌高麗菜絲，還有每日特餐上的一碗番茄湯嗎？

sentences.en: For drinks, we'll start with a bottle of sparkling water for the table and then decide on cocktails after we've ordered food.
sentences.zh: 飲料的部分，我們先來一瓶氣泡水放桌上，點完餐再決定雞尾酒。

sentences.en: I'd like my sandwich on whole wheat bread instead of white, and could you toast it lightly before adding the fillings?
sentences.zh: 我的三明治想用全麥麵包代替白麵包，而且加餡料之前可以稍微烤一下嗎？

sentences.en: My friend here is gluten-free, so could you indicate which items on the menu are safe for her to eat?
sentences.zh: 我這位朋友不能吃麩質，你能指出菜單上哪些對她來說是安全的嗎？

sentences.en: We originally ordered the small size, but after seeing how hungry everyone is, we'd like to upgrade to the large.
sentences.zh: 我們原本點了小份的，但看到大家都很餓，我們想升級成大份。

sentences.en: I think I'll try the daily special, which the server mentioned is a slow-cooked lamb shank with rosemary potatoes.
sentences.zh: 我想試試每日特餐，服務生提到是慢燉羊腿配迷迭香馬鈴薯。

sentences.en: Can we get the kids' meals with juice boxes instead of soda, since we prefer not to give our children sugary drinks?
sentences.zh: 兒童餐可以配果汁盒而不是汽水嗎？因為我們不想給孩子喝含糖飲料。

sentences.en: I'll have the same thing I ordered last time, which was the teriyaki chicken bowl with brown rice and steamed broccoli.
sentences.zh: 我要跟上次點的一樣，就是照燒雞肉飯配糙米和清蒸花椰菜。

sentences.en: Actually, I'd like to change my order if it hasn't gone to the kitchen yet — I've decided on the pasta instead.
sentences.zh: 如果還沒送到廚房的話，我想改一下點的東西——我決定要義大利麵了。

sentences.en: Could you bring everything at the same time so that we can all eat together, rather than serving each dish as it's ready?
sentences.zh: 你們可以一次全部上齊讓我們一起吃嗎？而不是每道準備好就先上。
